name: Single-kernel Octree Traversal
definition: A technique for traversing an octree for ray tracing by performing the entire traversal logic (including recursion simulation) within a single CUDA kernel execution per ray, rather than using multiple kernel launches for each recursion depth.
summary: Single-kernel octree traversal simulates recursion within one CUDA kernel per ray to eliminate launch overhead, using a fixed local memory stack instead of multiple kernel calls.
